snippets.title: Background Image
snippets.description: Adds a non-repeating background image to the message body.

snippets.title: Breadcrumbs
snippets.description: Formats selected text as bold, condensed breadcrumbs, replacing `>>` with dark red `»` separators.

snippets.title: Clean Subject
snippets.description: Removes repeated leading `Re:`, `Fwd:`, and `AW:` subject prefixes.

snippets.title: Keyboard Key
snippets.description: Styles selected text as a dark keyboard key with white lettering.

snippets.title: Number Badge
snippets.description: Displays the selection in a circular dark red badge with white lettering.

snippets.title: Remove All Style Blocks
snippets.description: Removes style blocks from the head and body; preserves inline style attributes.

snippets.title: Remove Body Style Blocks
snippets.description: Removes body style blocks, including in unquoted content; preserves head styles and inline style attributes.

snippets.title: Screenshot Frame
snippets.description: Wraps the selection in a rounded frame with a subtle border and drop shadow.

snippets.title: Shadow Box
snippets.description: Wraps the selection in a box with a subtle border and drop shadow.

snippets.title: Snipped Image Placeholder
snippets.description: Inserts a pink “IMAGE SNIPPED” notice with a tooltip; does not remove images automatically.

snippets.title: Yellow Highlighter
snippets.description: Highlights selected text in translucent yellow with rounded corners.
